title: 第32章 让王乃香分户，带走王乃香
content_zh:
第32章 让王乃香分户，带走王乃香-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

当即！！

李青山便和李胜利说了刚刚发生的事情，一个大男人竟然对一个女人动手？

实在可恶。

“什么玩意？”

“赵强，你个狗东西打你嫂子了？”

果然。

李胜利听到后，也是暴怒，指着赵强怒斥道。

赵强低着头，不敢言语。

李青山走上前去，将柔弱的王乃香从地上搀起来，单薄的身子已经没什么力气了。

王乃香的身子很轻。

李青山估计自己一只手就能将其抱起来，也就七十多斤的样子，但是肉全都长在该长的地方了，一股淡淡的女子体香席卷弥漫而来，令人微醺。

将其搀在旁边的椅子上后，李青山悄无声息取出一块绿豆糕，背着人塞入王乃香的口中。

王乃香被搀着的时候本来就是弯着腰，又是背着人。

望着李青山手中递过来的绿豆糕，还夹杂着几分绿豆的清香味道，这是自己这辈子都难以品尝到的好东西。

微微一怔。

还未反应过来，香甜的绿豆糕便被李青山塞入王乃香的柔软的嘴唇边。

王乃香急忙张开小嘴，将一整块绿豆糕都吃了进去。

刚入口。

清甜的味道，便在口中释放，不断刺激着味蕾，口感柔腻……！

真好吃！

真甜！

原本绝望和苍白的世界，此刻都多彩了起来，缓缓坐在旁边的椅子上，抓着眼前男人的手腕，安全感满满。

李青山也感觉到一双柔弱的小手抓着自己。

悄无声息的将手背在身后，旋即反握住王乃香的小手，将其抓在自己粗糙的宽大手掌之内，任由把玩。

王乃香心中小鹿乱撞。

当然，这点小动作。

周围村民自是没有见到的，这两个家伙在这个时候，竟然还在增进感情。

“村长，这也不能怪我家儿子啊，实在是王乃香这个扫把星害死了我家大儿子，又害的我家小儿子运气全无，摸牌的时候尽输，更是害的我们被人家赶出家门，宅子都没有了。”

“我们家不想要这个扫把星了，想要把她改嫁出去！”

“结果，这扫把星死活不同意，非要赖在我们家！”

“村长，这可怎么能行啊！”

“我们已经被这个扫把星害的够惨了，要是让她继续在我们家待着，我们全家老少恐怕都要被这个扫把星给害死了。”

“我儿子气不过，这才上手打了两下，也没真的用力去打。”

“就是想要吓唬吓唬她，让她去改嫁！”

Chapter 32 Let Wang Naixiang be separated into households and take away Wang Naixiang - "Cash the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

Previous chapter

Next chapter

Immediately!!

Li Qingshan told Li Shengli what had just happened. A grown man actually attacked a woman?

It's really hateful.

"What the hell?"

"Zhao Qiang, you bitch beat your sister-in-law?"

Sure enough.

After Li Shengli heard this, he was furious and pointed at Zhao Qiang and yelled angrily.

Zhao Qiang lowered his head and did not dare to speak.

Li Qingshan stepped forward and lifted the weak Wang Naixiang up from the ground. His frail body had no strength left.

Wang Naixiang's body is very light.

Li Qingshan estimated that he could hold it up with one hand. It only weighed more than seventy kilograms, but the flesh was all where it should be. A faint female body fragrance swept through the air, making people slightly tipsy.

After putting it on the chair next to him, Li Qingshan quietly took out a piece of mung bean cake and stuffed it into Wang Naixiang's mouth behind his back.

When Wang Naixiang was being carried, she was bent over and carrying someone on her back.

Looking at the mung bean cake handed over by Li Qingshan, it still contains a bit of the fragrance of mung beans. This is a good thing that he has never tasted in his life.

Startled slightly.

Before he could react, Li Qingshan stuffed the sweet mung bean cake into Wang Naixiang's soft lips.

Wang Naixiang hurriedly opened her mouth and ate a whole piece of mung bean cake.

Just entered.

The sweet taste is released in the mouth, constantly stimulating the taste buds, and the taste is soft and creamy...!

So delicious!

So sweet!

The originally hopeless and pale world became more colorful at this moment. He slowly sat on the chair next to him and grabbed the wrist of the man in front of him, feeling full of security.

Li Qingshan also felt a pair of weak hands holding him.

Quietly, he put his hands behind his back, and immediately took Wang Naixiang's small hand, holding it in his rough and wide palm, letting him play with it.

Wang Naixiang's heart was racing.

Of course, this is a small gesture.

The surrounding villagers did not see that these two guys were still strengthening their relationship at this time.

"Village Chief, you can't blame my son for this. It's really Wang Naixiang, the broomstick, who killed my eldest son. He also caused my younger son to lose all his luck and lose when playing cards. It even caused us to be kicked out of our house and our house was lost."

"Our family no longer wants this broom star, we want to remarry her!"

"In the end, this bad guy refused to agree and insisted on staying in our family!"

"Village Chief, how can this be possible?"

"We have suffered enough from this broom star. If she continues to stay in our home, our whole family, young and old, may be killed by this broom star."

"My son was so angry that he hit him twice, but he didn't hit him hard enough."

"I just want to scare her and make her remarry!"
